text: 'cat': distill, concept, views, brief, then build/critique x3 max

concept: A chunky, symmetrical orange tabby cat sitting upright, facing the viewer, with a round head, two pointed slope-brick ears, a cream muzzle and chest, and a short stubby tail built from two or three bricks curling up behind. (changed: Whiskers dropped, or replaced by two short grey bars per side, because thin flexible whiskers cannot be built reliably; Long curved tail became a 2-3 brick upright stub because free-standing curves are not buildable)
drawing the concept as an official LEGO set
turning the concept to see its side and back
reading the concept and writing the build brief
comparing the renders with the concept

score 4/10: The eyes are flat dark-grey 2x2 plates with a big white dot, so they read as goggles. The concept has large, round, glossy black eyes.; A brown arch sits over the eyes and looks like a hat. Tabby stripes should be a thin forehead stripe and side bands instead.; The head is a narrow box the same width as the body. The concept has an oversized round head that is wider than the body.
comparing the renders with the concept

score 4/10: Eyes are flat square 2x2 black plates with studs showing, so they read as sunglasses rather than the big round glossy eyes in the concept; Nose is too small and sits flat in the muzzle, so it disappears; the concept has a clear pink button nose that sticks out; The face lacks depth: the eyes need to stick out from the head the way the domed eyes do in the concept
comparing the renders with the concept

score 5/10: Eyes are black round bricks sticking straight out of the face like cylinders. The concept has large, flat, glossy 2x2 dome eyes with a white highlight.; Ears are short 2x2 stubs. The concept ears are tall, pointed and angled out, with tan inner faces.; The pink nose is small and sits too low under the eyes. It should sit on the tan muzzle, right between and just below the eyes.
